description: We are a passionate team of students interested in technology, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Analysis, and Space Science. We enjoy learning new technologies, solving problems, and developing innovative solutions. We are looking for enthusiastic team members who have skills in Python, Java, AI/ML, web development, research, and creative thinking. Let's work together and create something innovative!
summary: Our project, AI-Based Solar Butterfly, focuses on developing an intelligent butterfly-inspired system using Artificial Intelligence and solar energy concepts. The project combines a simulated butterfly model, an AI processing unit, communication systems, and a battery and motor circuit. The system is designed and simulated using MATLAB/Simulink to demonstrate the working of different components. The main objective is to explore how AI and solar energy technologies can be combined to create an innovative and efficient system. This project encourages sustainable technology, intelligent automation, and creative engineering solutions.
details: Our project, AI-Based Solar Butterfly, is designed to explore the combination of Artificial Intelligence concepts and solar energy technology. The system is developed and simulated using MATLAB/Simulink. It consists of a simulated butterfly model, signal duty block, AI chip representation, transmitter and receiver (TX & RX), electrical circuit, battery, motor, and output scope. The simulation represents the connection and interaction between these components. The AI section represents intelligent processing, while the battery and motor section represents the power and movement system. Tools Used: 1. MATLAB/Simulink 2. Signal Processing 3. Artificial Intelligence concepts 4. Electrical Circuit Simulation The main aim is to explore innovative engineering solutions by combining intelligent systems, simulation, and sustainable energy concepts.
